integrity: Original graph definitions, quantifier bounds, and proof of the periodicity and binary rigidity are stated. Prior matching-cut and perfect-coloring literature is compared explicitly. Historical priority is provisional; no independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the labelled generalized Petersen graphs with inner step three and n at least seven. Counts only minimum one-limited dominating vertex sets; does not count non-minima or other inner steps. The proof is mathematical and the finite verifier is corroborative rather than an infinite certificate.
title: Optimal one-limited domination sets of generalized Petersen graphs with inner step three
